Ligue Bois 2 : Dépensez vos Gemmes d'Énergie pour invoquer des HOUND et GUARD sur vos Pentagrammes et activez chaque serviteur une fois par tour. De nouvelles classes et capacités seront débloquées dans les ligues supérieures.

 Objectif

Duel tactique inspiré du plateau d'Overlord de Conan: Book of Skelos et du Labyrinthe de Nerdna. Répartissez vos Gemmes d'Énergie à chaque tour entre l'invocation de serviteurs sur les Pentagrammes et l'activation de vos légions pour détruire le Sanctuaire (Sanctum) de l'Overlord rival !

 Règles

Bronze+ League: Frenzy Double-Activation is now unlocked! You may activate the same minion up to 2 times per turn (1 Gem for the first activation, 2 Gems for the second).

 The Goal

Asymmetric tactical board-game duel inspired by Conan: Book of Skelos (Overlord Dashboard) and Nerdna's Labyrinth. Allocate your Energy Gems each turn between summoning undead legions on Pentagrams and activating minions to destroy the rival Overlord's Sanctum!

 Rules

The battle unfolds on a symmetric 11×11 thin-wall labyrinth where every tile is walkable, separated by directional thin walls along cell edges (encoded per cell as a hexadecimal bitmask 0–F: 1=North, 2=East, 4=South, 8=West), with two Overlord Sanctums (40 HP each, at (1, 5) and (9, 5)) and 5 Summoning Pentagrams.

Energy Gems & Minion Legions

At the start of each turn, each Overlord receives fresh Energy Gems equal to 5 + leagueLevel + controlledPentagrams (unspent Gems do not carry over). You can spend Gems on two types of commands:

  • SUMMON pentagramId TYPE: Summons a new minion onto an unoccupied Pentagram that you control:
    • HOUND (Cost 2 Gems, 12 HP, 4 ATK, Speed 2, Range 1): Fast hunter.
    • GUARD (Cost 3 Gems, 24 HP, 6 ATK, Speed 1, Range 1): Heavy armored skeleton.
    • WRAITH (Cost 4 Gems, 14 HP, 7 ATK, Speed 1, Range 2): Ranged spectral caster.
  • ACTIVATE minionId targetX targetY (Frenzy: up to 2 activations/turn per minion — 1 Gem for 1st, 2 Gems for 2nd): Commands an owned minion to advance up to its Speed orthogonal steps toward (targetX, targetY), capturing Pentagrams stepped on and striking the enemy Sanctum when adjacent (+8 points).

End-of-Turn Combat & Scoring

  1. After all SUMMON and ACTIVATE commands resolve, every active minion automatically attacks the weakest enemy minion within its Manhattan Range (1 for Hound/Guard, 2 for Wraith).
  2. Each enemy minion slain awards +5 points to the killer.
  3. At the end of the turn, each player gains +2 points per controlled Pentagram.
  4. Reducing the enemy Sanctum to 0 HP immediately ends the match and awards a +50 point victory bonus!
Victory Conditions
  • Destroy the rival Overlord's Sanctum or have a higher score after 90 turns.
Defeat Conditions
  • Your Sanctum is destroyed or you have a lower score than your opponent after 90 turns.
  • Your program times out or outputs an invalid command.

 Game Input

Initialization Input

Line 1: 3 space-separated integers width, height and leagueLevel, the dimensions of the labyrinth (11×11) and the current league level (1, 2 or 3).

Line 2: 4 space-separated integers mySanctumX, mySanctumY, oppSanctumX and oppSanctumY, the coordinates of your Overlord Sanctum and your opponent's Sanctum.

Input for One Game Turn

Line 1: 3 space-separated integers gems, mySanctumHp and oppSanctumHp, your available Energy Gems for this turn and the remaining HP of both Sanctums.

Next height lines: a string row of length width of uppercase hexadecimal digits (0–F), where each digit encodes the directional thin walls on that cell's edges (1=North, 2=East, 4=South, 8=West).

Next line: an integer pentagramCount, the number of Summoning Pentagrams (5).

Next pentagramCount lines: 4 space-separated integers pentagramId, px, py and owner (-1 = neutral, 0 = controlled by you, 1 = controlled by opponent).

Next line: an integer minionCount, the total number of active minions on the board.

Next minionCount lines: 6 space-separated values minionId, minionOwner, type, x, y and hp:

  • minionId: unique integer ID of the minion.
  • minionOwner: 0 if owned by you (listed first), 1 if owned by your opponent.
  • type: minion class string (HOUND, GUARD or WRAITH).
  • x, y: integer coordinates of the minion.
  • hp: current integer HP of the minion.
Output for One Game Turn

A single line containing one or more semicolon-separated (;) commands (or WAIT):

  • SUMMON pentagramId TYPE where TYPE is HOUND, GUARD or WRAITH.
  • ACTIVATE minionId targetX targetY

Example: ACTIVATE 0 9 5 ; SUMMON 0 GUARD

Constraints
width = 11, height = 11
pentagramCount = 5
0 ≤ minionCount ≤ 24
Response time for the first turn ≤ 1000 ms
Response time per turn ≤ 50 ms
Maximum number of turns: 90
